app.title: HACS Trends
view.trending.title: Gaining attention
view.trending.note: The repositories picking up the most new stars in the period. Stars measure visibility, not use — {installed} is the counterweight.
view.installed.title: Actually being used
view.installed.note: Ranked by installations that really run. From opt-in Home Assistant analytics, so a large sample rather than a headcount — good for ranking, not for exact user numbers. Integrations only: {matched} of {withDomain} are matched.
view.breakout.title: Rising for their size
view.breakout.note: Growth in percent, so small projects are not buried under the big ones. Repositories below {minBase} stars at the start of the period are excluded — the corpus median is 13 stars, and without a floor this list would be projects that went from 2 stars to 4.
view.momentum.title: Real momentum
view.momentum.note: Ranked on the lower of two percentiles — star rate and installation rate — so a project has to be strong in both. Each component rank has its own column; the placement is never a black box. Integrations only, and repositories whose domain is claimed by several projects are excluded rather than ranked on an ambiguous number.
view.ships.title: Ships reliably
view.ships.note: Ranked by releases published in the last year. Releases and commits sit side by side on purpose: 100 releases against 1,700 commits is a pipeline publishing on every merge, while 10 against 87 is a maintainer deciding to ship. Both are legitimate — the numbers let you tell them apart. A value shown as 100+ means the count hit the fetch limit; within that block the most recent release ranks first.
view.maintenance.title: Possibly unmaintained
view.maintenance.note: A prompt to look, not a verdict. A small, finished integration for a device with a stable API can be correct for years without a commit. Across HACS the median is {median} days since the last commit; a tenth are past {p90} days.
view.fresh.title: New in HACS
view.fresh.note: Recently accepted into the HACS store, by when a repository first appeared in our own collection.
window.starsExact: Star figures are exact for every period — the full history was collected once.
window.installsGrowing: Installation trends have to build up over time. They start on {date}.
hint.rankKept: Position in this view's unfiltered ranking.
hint.ambiguousDomain: Several HACS repositories claim this integration domain, so the figure cannot be attributed to one of them.
hint.starsAdded: Stars given during the period. GitHub does not report removed stars, so this is not a net change.
hint.integrationsOnly: Installation figures exist for integrations only — dashboard cards, themes and templates are not reported.
hint.noAdoption: The release tag does not appear in the analytics data, so the share is unknown — which is not the same as zero.
hint.adoption: Share of reported installations running {v}, the newest release.
hint.noRelease: This repository has never published a release.
foot.empty: Nothing matches. Try a different search or clear the filters.
foot.downloadCoverage: download counter for only {pct}% — no ranking of its own
foot.installsSample: installs are an opt-in sample, integrations only
